name: agent-skills
description: A collection of installable Claude Code plugins and agent skills.

plugins.name: interactive-code-review
plugins.description: Walk a reviewer through a change set one change at a time, interactively — a guided, grill-me-style review session in COMMENT mode (post GitHub comments) or FIX mode (apply fixes locally).

plugins.name: evolve
plugins.description: LLM-driven evolutionary code optimizer. Mutates code in isolated git worktrees, evaluates fitness, and surfaces the best variant.
